1. (Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __that does not chemically disrupt the embryo cell wall__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material __by a method comprising exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation__; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos __wherein the embryo remains viable after steps (a) through (c)__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water __and does not include chemical cell wall disrupting agents__.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation __without use of enzymatic cell wall degradation__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated __at least twice__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by heating of the shed cellular material and agitation __without prior cold exposure and without enzymatic cell wall degradation__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated __at least twice__.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with an enzyme __that is a cell wall degrading enzyme applied after physical disruption of the shed cellular material__.

8. (Original) The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME@.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA __using magnetic particle-based extraction without prior enzymatic treatment of the shed cellular material__.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material __and wherein the magnetic particles are applied directly to the shed cellular material without prior enzymatic digestion__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos __that retain viability and germination capacity following steps (a) through (c)__.

12. (Original) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d).

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping __performed without prior whole genome amplification of the DNA__.

14. (Original) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant __wherein the phenotype is correlated with the genotype determined in step (c)__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed __only when the DNA obtained in step (b) is insufficient for the molecular analysis__.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype __wherein the selection occurs before germination and the selected embryos retain viability__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __wherein germination occurs after genotype-based selection__.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated __and wherein the automated steps do not include the germination step__.
